description: Handwriting regression fix behind IDP_PROBE_VLM_FOR_HANDWRITING (default '1', ON) (ITEM 4). RE-adds a flag-gated handwriting signal end-to-end: handwriting_prob back on SampleObs/DocPrior/PageProbe; cfg.vlm_for_handwriting + cfg.hw_threshold (default 0.30) with from_env parsing; probe.py Phase B still calls the VLM for confident-latin SAMPLED pages only when the flag is ON so handwriting_prob comes from the VLM; aggregate.py carries it; routing.decide_route gains a flag-gated latin+handwriting branch (-> paddleocr_handwritten); vlm_probe re-adds handwriting_fraction. Non-Latin unchanged (still -> vlm). decide_route with no handwriting_prob is byte-identical to today. Tests extend tests/test_probe.py. Independent of FEAT-001/002.
steps: types.py: on ProbeConfig add fields vlm_for_handwriting: bool = True and hw_threshold: float = 0.30; in from_env add c.vlm_for_handwriting = _env('VLM_FOR_HANDWRITING','1') == '1' and c.hw_threshold = float(_env('HW_THRESHOLD', str(c.hw_threshold))). Re-add handwriting_prob: Optional[float] = None to SampleObs, DocPrior, and PageProbe (Optional default None so existing constructions stay valid). Keep ROUTE_HANDWRITTEN.

routing.py: add keyword-only param handwriting_prob: Optional[float] = None (default None) to decide_route; import ROUTE_HANDWRITTEN. Inside the existing `if script == 'latin':` branch, BEFORE returning ROUTE_PRINTED, add: if handwriting_prob is not None and handwriting_prob >= cfg.hw_threshold -> return RouteChoice(route=ROUTE_HANDWRITTEN, ocr_lang=SCRIPT_TO_PADDLE_LANG['latin'], use_structure=has_table, reason='latin_handwritten'). No non-Latin branch changes. With handwriting_prob=None the function stays byte-identical to today.

vlm_probe.py: add '"handwriting_fraction": <0-1>' back into the _PROMPT JSON schema; in BedrockScriptProbe.observe set handwriting_prob=_clip01(data.get('handwriting_fraction'), 0.0) on the returned SampleObs.

aggregate.py: in aggregate_doc compute a doc-level handwriting value = mean of o.handwriting_prob over obs where it is not None (else None) and pass DocPrior(handwriting_prob=...). Leave samples_disagree and nearest_sample script-based (no handwriting-spread branch).

probe.py Phase B _observe: add the flag-gated extra VLM call: when cfg.vlm_for_handwriting AND the onnx obs resolved script=='latin' with script_confidence >= cfg.onnx_min_conf AND not obs.mixed_scripts (the case that currently SKIPS the VLM) AND vlm is not None and cfg.vlm_enabled, make ONE vlm.observe call and copy ONLY its handwriting_prob onto the onnx obs (keep onnx script/confidence). Flag OFF or non-latin/low-conf/mixed -> unchanged (no extra call).

probe.py Phase C: extend _page_values to also resolve hw = (samp.handwriting_prob if heterogeneous and samp else prior.handwriting_prob), falling back to samp.handwriting_prob when prior has none; pass handwriting_prob=hw into BOTH decide_route call sites (the `for pn in nonblank` loop and the `for pn in timed_out` loop) and set handwriting_prob=hw on the PageProbe(...) constructions. Keep every other value identical.

lambda_probe_handler.py: OPTIONAL — only if _SLIM_FIELDS is an allow-list and the slim-output test needs handwriting_prob surfaced, add it; otherwise leave unchanged. Do NOT change the four engine-contract keys.

tests/test_probe.py: extend StubVLM with an hw=None ctor arg that sets handwriting_prob=hw on the returned SampleObs (keep per_page / (script,conf) usage working). Add cases: (i) flag ON + sampled confident-latin onnx obs (injected fake session peaking on latin) + stub VLM hw=0.9 -> page routes to paddleocr_handwritten; (ii) flag OFF same inputs -> no extra VLM call for that page and route paddleocr_printed; (iii) non-latin confident script (e.g. devanagari) never triggers VLM-for-handwriting and still routes to vlm_transcribe; (iv) decide_route with no handwriting_prob supplied is byte-identical (latin .9 -> paddleocr_printed/en) and decide_route(script='latin', script_conf=.9, handwriting_prob=0.9, cfg=_cfg(), mixed=False, is_blank=False, has_table=False) -> paddleocr_handwritten. Mock all ONNX via injected session= and VLM via stub; NO real model, NO torch, NO AWS.
acceptance_criteria: ProbeConfig has vlm_for_handwriting (default True) and hw_threshold (default 0.30) with from_env parsing; SampleObs/DocPrior/PageProbe carry Optional handwriting_prob.

decide_route with no handwriting_prob is byte-identical to today (latin conf>=min -> paddleocr_printed/en); with latin + handwriting_prob >= hw_threshold -> paddleocr_handwritten; non-Latin never yields paddleocr_handwritten or paddleocr_printed.
With the flag ON, a sampled confident-latin page gets a VLM call for handwriting; with the flag OFF it does not, and behavior matches today.
tests/test_probe.py passes including the 4 new/updated cases, and the pre-existing tests remain green.
verification: c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\IDP\engineer_a\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from src.ai.layer1_probe.routing import decide_route; from src.ai.layer1_probe.types import ProbeConfig as P; c=P(); import inspect; assert 'handwriting_prob' in inspect.signature(decide_route).parameters; r=decide_route(script='latin',script_conf=.9,mixed=False,is_blank=False,has_table=False,cfg=c); assert r.route=='paddleocr_printed'; r2=decide_route(script='latin',script_conf=.9,mixed=False,is_blank=False,has_table=False,cfg=c,handwriting_prob=0.9); assert r2.route=='paddleocr_handwritten'"
findings: Implemented ITEM 4 across types.py (vlm_for_handwriting=True + hw_threshold=0.30 on ProbeConfig with from_env parsing of IDP_PROBE_VLM_FOR_HANDWRITING / IDP_PROBE_HW_THRESHOLD; re-added Optional handwriting_prob to SampleObs, DocPrior, PageProbe), routing.py (keyword-only handwriting_prob=None on decide_route; latin+handwriting>=hw_threshold -> paddleocr_handwritten, else unchanged; byte-identical when None), vlm_probe.py (handwriting_fraction back in _PROMPT; observe() sets handwriting_prob via _clip01), aggregate.py (doc-level handwriting_prob = mean over obs that carry one, else None), probe.py (Phase B flag-gated ONE extra VLM call for confident-latin SKIP case, adopting ONLY handwriting_prob from VLM; Phase C _page_values resolves hw and threads it into both decide_route call sites and the PageProbe). lambda_probe_handler._SLIM_FIELDS left unchanged (allow-list; not required). Tests: extended StubVLM with hw ctor arg and added 4 cases (flag ON confident-latin hw=0.9 -> handwritten + VLM called; flag OFF -> printed + no extra VLM call; confident devanagari -> vlm_transcribe + no VLM-for-handwriting; decide_route optional/gated). tests/test_probe.py + tests/test_line_crops.py = 34 passed (27 baseline + 3 line-crop + 4 new). The onnx_classifier_contract assertion (no 'hw_prob' abbreviated field) remains satisfied since the field is named handwriting_prob. No .onnx touched/staged; no edits to docker/, step_functions/, or src/ai/layer1_routing/.
